title: Certify maps and set operators over sets in Lean via the clause log
summary: The clause-log exporter and Lean reconstructor now certify maps of not/and/or/=> over sets, Z3's set operators (union, intersection, setminus, complement), and input default values over Int and Real indices, with no new axioms. z3test t8.smt2 (De Morgan over sets) and two queries of issue-1665.smt2 now verify in Lean.
